Game Overview

In Sky Balloon Brawl, the core idea is straightforward: take to the skies in Sky Balloon Brawl, an addictive arcade throwback where you dodge crafty mice while bursting their balloons. With pixelated charm and a thrilling soundtrack, this quick-paced challenge gets tougher as you soar higher. Navigate clever foes to become the ultimate aerial ace!
